Korean hangover drinks (*sukchwihaeso-eumryo* , 숙취해소음료) are functional beverages and shots designed to support alcohol breakdown and ease next-day symptoms, traditionally taken before or after drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXaVGOXjBDvx433cnvdpC1dj7FmjjhlAjFqCe8FRaIT2fEk9m7vwyXzftvO1fdNdce_rYGGnbI-2WhVaOvyzRdsDqiNwRaBDeucvjVHcof7_F4KB1O3lTAAqyZnpoO9HQLag)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:9940710093307358434,catalogid:5461966654484604599,gpcid:10326408673632743076,mid:576462531126619772&ibp=oshop)

### Common Types & Popular Options

- **Classic Herbal Shots:** [CJ Healthcare Condition](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXO8du1yizkVaiVTJoD-xctW7BijrrXxkcs6XI2V4dDUVws-iZOZ4WgrmY8eAKJ0-MEnulskyZ-qCGVsVplZQIogrsK2nn5VVpD1wtV6WcXsh97su9L-gX7ZLL9w-6-qqj2zcbUSXr--bm1iw) (launched in 1992 by HK inno.N) is South Korea's best-known hangover drink, formulated with oriental raisin tree fruit (*Hovenia dulcis* ), fermented rice germ, and other plant extracts.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXO8du1yizkVaiVTJoD-xctW7BijrrXxkcs6XI2V4dDUVws-iZOZ4WgrmY8eAKJ0-MEnulskyZ-qCGVsVplZQIogrsK2nn5VVpD1wtV6WcXsh97su9L-gX7ZLL9w-6-qqj2zcbUSXr--bm1iw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXJ81NzvR5OZnLQ9tufVgqiQMteHJ-fAsuHGBnaNxi8amFB8GWnajdXG0rhVCXJ0T9IaatPsQhk6l3w9E-TRPwfk3IKgxARb5u53zUMz3yd4KQ3rFrxGKVXVNE5JajMtOv30_f2A)
- **Korean Pear & Tonic Blends:** Drinks like Seoul Tonic combine Korean pear with ingredients like *Hovenia dulcis* , red ginseng, or apple cider vinegar for hydration and digestion support.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:7773848198322154869,catalogid:9337266216681786285,gpcid:2932950006389414629,mid:576462872091453704&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:9940710093307358434,catalogid:5461966654484604599,gpcid:10326408673632743076,mid:576462531126619772&ibp=oshop)
- **Hovenia Teas:** Ready-to-drink teas such as Lotte Hovenia Tea offer a milder, zero-calorie option centered on *Hovenia dulcis* extract.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:9122333810641820910,catalogid:16483514391511333153,gpcid:14314434098263767646,mid:576462807528170662&ibp=oshop)
- **Flavored & Mixer Shots:** Brands like [Sukhee](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXHAdW35CrupaGL3YFd1SVljT5kFSedTigRsJ9LKX93KIvkwAio1IFw8V5IQMHpw18RNbPwUoLoUQV4StIMHrCcPFc1iRqs26k4AA0aTqdtuE3ESgVNM7aNWCYgWu3_KAtX4yPouQTcHFUo_8iRVPISAtgVDFdZrS1) offer sweet fruit or cocktail-style shots (such as yuja, mojito, or red grapefruit).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXHAdW35CrupaGL3YFd1SVljT5kFSedTigRsJ9LKX93KIvkwAio1IFw8V5IQMHpw18RNbPwUoLoUQV4StIMHrCcPFc1iRqs26k4AA0aTqdtuE3ESgVNM7aNWCYgWu3_KAtX4yPouQTcHFUo_8iRVPISAtgVDFdZrS1)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXSfL5XlBeHUKLIGMbjRNq_IUjMnhtFyLzd6LC92QtJtbiauMXZDFKs5uhBK8USmNdMt5Rf97lHa352Oa3gJOi1NsPFRcAHN0LuX3fFzhRHZnMr76XlQSfxoq9e6DrBa-haDTAbpoFmg)

### Key Ingredients & How They're Used

- **Hovenia dulcis (Oriental raisin tree):** Widely used in Korean remedies as a source of dihydromyricetin (DHM) and other plant compounds to support liver and alcohol metabolism.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStAEBxCJF1xK_ELER4CzjOqfW5POFzT_aFljOUZvSwZ1SVX5S7nKRCVW-Imy7ag2F5vJBhFxy1qJ6PXr4y-WYxBJ5VdQaVxiEhSZ4uVGx2QyvxeIx6ZiDTRJb-PWkfL2akgH5YRAqCzgvpHZ_D5v2tY4PPuwKlHjkoeVjWl8lgRAoCjD5ypqBo5n6okchTA4gE_FRi_fTrH-UJcMI8BOM_w4Hk15a9eaBIM5UzbIxzVc4yoGQhfg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX0qcgHbKPPsP_POXLrF65rJq3VM8BVmVje53TQRWJ3HWO9S5A9ba08x88-c6YjVkQUtheiBFbiGGgmi8GD2P7Mzb7fQ8CzWfVNA_Od4XGcGQou_W9MdBrTPYWjPytaAPmreadmSf4P8ypq-rtrA)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:237871046150107820&ibp=oshop)
- **Korean pear, herbs & vitamins:** Often added for hydration, taste, and general recovery support.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX0qcgHbKPPsP_POXLrF65rJq3VM8BVmVje53TQRWJ3HWO9S5A9ba08x88-c6YjVkQUtheiBFbiGGgmi8GD2P7Mzb7fQ8CzWfVNA_Od4XGcGQou_W9MdBrTPYWjPytaAPmreadmSf4P8ypq-rtrA)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:7773848198322154869,catalogid:9337266216681786285,gpcid:2932950006389414629,mid:576462872091453704&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:9940710093307358434,catalogid:5461966654484604599,gpcid:10326408673632743076,mid:576462531126619772&ibp=oshop)
- **Timing & expectations:** Many people drink them before a night out or right after drinking alongside water. While some formulas have clinical data on acetaldehyde clearance or symptoms, evidence on hangover remedies varies, and no drink prevents intoxication or replaces pacing and hydration.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXuT-qDC6ET_j_dLPCDsP-6MaZbwsfXh1cE1NmB0SJEQLL8zhrDpKpUue2uDKsfL-sbk76lprIfu95ifrKNYvzv4nfnp3bDgL5rdW1X-Qb3tspaWIIGSjvGGo7tnYc5v2RUrRxDcHVla0)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX0qcgHbKPPsP_POXLrF65rJq3VM8BVmVje53TQRWJ3HWO9S5A9ba08x88-c6YjVkQUtheiBFbiGGgmi8GD2P7Mzb7fQ8CzWfVNA_Od4XGcGQou_W9MdBrTPYWjPytaAPmreadmSf4P8ypq-rtrA)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:9940710093307358434,catalogid:5461966654484604599,gpcid:10326408673632743076,mid:576462531126619772&ibp=oshop)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXaVGOXjBDvx433cnvdpC1dj7FmjjhlAjFqCe8FRaIT2fEk9m7vwyXzftvO1fdNdce_rYGGnbI-2WhVaOvyzRdsDqiNwRaBDeucvjVHcof7_F4KB1O3lTAAqyZnpoO9HQLag)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXJ81NzvR5OZnLQ9tufVgqiQMteHJ-fAsuHGBnaNxi8amFB8GWnajdXG0rhVCXJ0T9IaatPsQhk6l3w9E-TRPwfk3IKgxARb5u53zUMz3yd4KQ3rFrxGKVXVNE5JajMtOv30_f2A)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStAEBxCJF1xK_ELER4CzjOqfW5POFzT_aFljOUZvSwZ1SVX5S7nKRCVW-Imy7ag2F5vJBhFxy1qJ6PXr4y-WYxBJ5VdQaVxiEhSZ4uVGx2QyvxeIx6ZiDTRJb-PWkfL2akgH5YRAqCzgvpHZ_D5v2tY4PPuwKlHjkoeVjWl8lgRAoCjD5ypqBo5n6okchTA4gE_FRi_fTrH-UJcMI8BOM_w4Hk15a9eaBIM5UzbIxzVc4yoGQhfg)
